== Summary ==
Lossless page extract from the complete official Set 9 PDF [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193358id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-9.pdf archived at 2021-10-05T19:33:58Z]. Extract pages 1, 2 and 3 are original pages 1, 3 and 5 respectively. Original embedded images, vector text and icons are retained without rasterization or lossy recompression; each extracted page renders and extracts text exactly as its original page. Complete original: seven readable pages, 123,968,985 bytes, SHA-256 <code>1a4a0ce08ac504a5cfe79b59c43c62f076af76b1c0014bcf4525bd39603dcb98</code>. The complete source exceeds the Wiki upload limit and remains preserved unchanged in the source archive. The capture dates this copy, not the unknown first publication day. Extract SHA-256 <code>de6b2735e32bd62d5829dff01d5f80fc53b30c2289f93e4d4a3b6baca0a135fb</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd.; published by the Players Committee.
